scope: Chinese text and Traditional counterpart checks, plus full-text editorial reading of all 30 foreign-language manuscripts by three parallel reviewers. Not native-human publishing certification. Exact review reports and published hashes are retained separately.
changes: Distinguish the Ritual Vessels Stele's stone, Ming rubbing and subsequent album; identify the shared heart component in xin and nian precisely.

For Zhang Menglong, retain the undated rubbing and separate handwriting structure from damage. Correct Korean words that confused rubbing characters with a table and an unidentified calligrapher with another meaning of the same syllables.
Wild Goose Pagoda: keep the 648 preface, 653 carving, album dimensions and uncertain rubbing date separate; do not conflate it with the 672 collected-Wang-Xizhi inscription.

Chive Flowers: retain the Wuxi transmitted version and disputed attribution, all 63 characters and the supplied complete translations. Do not turn this reproduction into a securely authenticated autograph.
Boyuan: retain the 47-character letter, omitted subjects and uncertainty about the occasion. Correct the neighboring-work title gloss without inventing a historical event.
Expand reference-style Markdown links into working inline links; preserve all examples, captions, source notes and optional philosophical readings.
images: Public preview verification is recorded in r2-verification-calligraphy-12-16.json. Received originals remain offline. Sources, credits, processing records and permission-status statements are retained; commentary use does not imply a new licence.
